preconditions.description: The maze dimensions n (rows) and m (columns) are within the bounds 1 to 2000.
The starting cell (r, c) is within the maze boundaries.
The maximum allowed left (x) and right (y) moves are non-negative integers up to 10^9.

preconditions.expression: len(maze) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in maze)
preconditions.description: The maze is a list of n rows, each containing exactly m characters.
The starting cell (r, c) is free (denoted by '.').

preconditions.expression: all(cell in {'.', '*'} for row in maze for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the maze is either free ('.') or an obstacle ('*').

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the count of reachable cells.

postconditions.expression: count == sum(1 for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(1, m+1) if is_reachable(i, j, x, y))
postconditions.description: The count is the number of cells (i, j) in the maze that are reachable from the starting cell (r, c) under the constraints of moving left no more than x times and right no more than y times.
The starting cell (r, c) is always considered reachable under the given movement constraints.

postconditions.expression: all(is_reachable(i, j, x, y) == False for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(1, m+1) if maze[i-1][j-1] == '*')
postconditions.description: Obstacle cells ('*') are never considered reachable.

postconditions.expression: all((is_reachable(i, j, x, y) == False or is_reachable(i, j, x, y) == True) for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(1, m+1))
postconditions.description: The reachability of each cell (i, j) is a boolean value (either True or False).
